dslRule:
<!id: simplify.static.method.fqn>
<!description: Replace fully qualified static method invocation with a simple name, adding static import.
This cleanup improves code readability and conciseness by replacing 'FQCN.method()' with 'method()'.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: static-import, style, readability, java-8>

$type.$methodName($args$) :: isStatic($methodName)
=>
$methodName($args$)
;;
summary: Simplifies fully qualified static method calls to their simple names by adding static imports.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
